title: How Do Households Respond to Expected Inflation? An Investigation of Transmission Mechanisms,
title_zh: 家庭如何应对预期通胀？传导机制研究
title_primary: 家庭如何应对预期通胀？传导机制研究
title_secondary: How Do Households Respond to Expected Inflation? An Investigation of Transmission Mechanisms,
authors: Janet Hua Jiang, Rupal Kamdar, Kelin Lu, Daniela Puzzello
source: Journal of the European Economic Association
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-03 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We investigate the channels through which inflation expectations affect household spending by conducting surveys featuring hypothetical scenarios involving an increase in inflation expectations. Most households did not adjust their current spending plans, often because they perceived inflation expectations as irrelevant or adhered to a fixed budget. Among those who did adjust, most decreased their spending, primarily due to wealth effects. Few households increased spending as prescribed by the traditional intertemporal substitution channel. We also document that financial conditions, cognitive ability, and subjective mental models—such as stagflationary expectations—help predict spending responses and the mechanisms households cite. Our findings provide insights into the discussion of using inflation expectations as a policy tool and highlight key frictions to incorporate into theoretical models.
abstract_zh: 我们通过开展涉及通胀预期上升假设情景的调查，探究了通胀预期影响家庭支出的渠道。大多数家庭并未调整其当前支出计划，这往往是因为他们认为通胀预期无关紧要或坚持固定预算。在确实进行调整的家庭中，多数减少了支出，主要归因于财富效应。少数家庭按照传统跨期替代渠道的指引增加了支出。我们还发现，财务状况、认知能力以及主观心智模型（如滞胀预期）有助于预测支出反应及家庭所引用的机制。我们的研究结果为关于将通胀预期作为政策工具的讨论提供了见解，并强调了需纳入理论模型的关键摩擦因素。

title: Agreements Must Be Kept? Residential Leases during Covid-19
title_zh: 契约必须信守？新冠疫情下的住宅租赁合同
title_primary: 契约必须信守？新冠疫情下的住宅租赁合同
title_secondary: Agreements Must Be Kept? Residential Leases during Covid-19
authors: Itai Ater, Yael Elster, David Genesove, Eran Hoffmann, Björn Marcus Asplund 等
official: 官方在线 2020-07-27 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper studies how a Covid-19 lockdown affected residential lease payments. Survey data on 1511 Israeli renter households show nearly one in eight households not paying full rent during the lockdown, with these households holding back, on average, a third of their contractually due rent. Financially fragile households with greater income cuts, and households with leases lacking provisions that effectively provide for damages upon non-payment pay a lower share of contract rent. So do households with more frequent encounters with their landlord, or longer tenure in the apartment. Bargaining and relational contracts theories help explain these results.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了新冠疫情封锁如何影响住宅租赁支付。针对1511户以色列租房家庭的调查数据显示，封锁期间近八分之一的家庭未全额支付租金，这些家庭平均扣留了合同规定租金的三分之一。财务脆弱、收入削减更大的家庭，以及租赁合同中缺乏有效违约赔偿条款的家庭，支付的合同租金比例较低。同样，与房东接触更频繁或在公寓居住时间更长的家庭也是如此。议价理论和关系契约理论有助于解释这些结果。

title: Population Aging and Income Inequality in a Semi‐Endogenous Growth Model
title_zh: 半内生增长模型中的人口老龄化与收入不平等
title_primary: 半内生增长模型中的人口老龄化与收入不平等
title_secondary: Population Aging and Income Inequality in a Semi‐Endogenous Growth Model
authors: KAZUO MINO, HIROAKI SASAKI
source: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
official: 官方在线 2026-07-28 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Using a continuous‐time overlapping generations model with semi‐endogenous growth, this study analyzes the impact of population aging on income inequality. We characterize the stationary distributions of household income and wealth and examine how increases in life expectancy and declines in fertility rates affect these distributions. Numerical simulations indicate that longer life expectancy reduces inequality, whereas lower fertility rates increase it. We further explore the distributional effects of exogenous productivity growth under varying degrees of population aging.
abstract_zh: 本研究采用包含半内生增长的连续时间世代交叠模型，分析人口老龄化对收入不平等的影响。我们刻画了家庭收入与财富的稳态分布特征，并考察预期寿命延长和生育率下降如何影响这些分布。数值模拟表明，预期寿命延长会降低不平等程度，而生育率下降则会加剧不平等。我们进一步探讨了在不同人口老龄化程度下，外生生产率增长对收入分配的影响。

title: Agentomics: Economic Foundations for the Valuation, Attribution, and Pricing of AI Agents in Human-AI Workflows
title_zh: Agentomics：人机工作流中AI代理的估值、归因与定价的经济学基础
title_primary: Agentomics：人机工作流中AI代理的估值、归因与定价的经济学基础
title_secondary: Agentomics: Economic Foundations for the Valuation, Attribution, and Pricing of AI Agents in Human-AI Workflows
authors: Quanyan Zhu
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Agentic AI systems are increasingly being deployed as productive resources in organizational workflows, yet existing evaluation methods primarily measure isolated technical performance rather than economic contribution. This paper introduces \emph{Agentomics}, a workflow-based framework for valuing, attributing, and pricing human and artificial agents. The framework models a workflow as a configuration of heterogeneous agents whose collective performance determines gross value, deployment cost, reliability, and expected failure loss. Workflow value is treated as a team-level quantity that may include complementarities, substitution effects, bottlenecks, and nonlinear production; additive stage-level value is only a special case. Building on this workflow model, the paper formulates AI deployment as a coalition-formation problem and defines coalition value as the incremental net surplus generated relative to a benchmark human workflow. The Shapley value is then used to attribute economic surplus among participating AI agents, yielding a principled connection among valuation, accountability, and market pricing. The resulting Shapley pricing equilibrium provides a normative benchmark for assessing whether agent prices reflect expected marginal contribution. A security-operations case study illustrates how the framework accounts for productivity gains, deployment costs, reliability losses, and coalition-level complementarities in hybrid human--AI workflows.
abstract_zh: 自主型人工智能系统正越来越多地被部署为组织工作流程中的生产性资源，然而现有评估方法主要衡量孤立的技术性能而非经济贡献。本文提出"Agentomics"框架，这是一个基于工作流程的评估框架，用于对人类与人工智能代理进行价值评估、贡献归因和定价。该框架将工作流程建模为异质性代理的配置组合，其集体绩效决定了总价值、部署成本、可靠性和预期故障损失。工作流程价值被视为团队层面的量值，可能包含互补性、替代效应、瓶颈和非线性生产；可加性的阶段层面价值仅为特例。基于此工作流程模型，本文将人工智能部署形式化为联盟形成问题，并将联盟价值定义为相对于基准人类工作流程所产生的增量净剩余。随后采用沙普利值对参与的人工智能代理进行经济剩余归因，从而在价值评估、问责机制与市场定价之间建立原则性关联。由此产生的沙普利定价均衡为评估代理价格是否反映预期边际贡献提供了规范性基准。通过安全运营案例研究，本文展示了该框架如何核算人机混合工作流程中的生产力增益、部署成本、可靠性损失及联盟层面互补性。

title: Comparing perceived distributional equity in state-dominated and co-managed protected areas
title_zh: 比较国家主导和共同管理保护区的感知分配公平性
title_primary: 比较国家主导和共同管理保护区的感知分配公平性
title_secondary: Comparing perceived distributional equity in state-dominated and co-managed protected areas
authors: Ying Lou, Yuqi Zhang, Yin Zhang, Yongbing Zhang, Zichen Fang 等
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-18 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Distributional equity is pivotal to the coordination between protected areas and local development because it affects local legitimacy, compliance, and support for conservation. Nevertheless, the socio-institutional mechanisms that shape local perceptions of such fairness remain insufficiently understood. Applying the Social-Ecological Systems Framework, we compared two archetypal governance arrangements in China: Wolong Nature Reserve (state-dominated) and Tangjiahe Nature Reserve (co-managed), to examine how differing governance arrangements and socioeconomic factors jointly shape equity perceptions in protected-area contexts. Based on both quantitative questionnaires (n = 593) and qualitative interviews (n = 78), our findings reveal that overall perceived distributional equity is moderately positive, with higher scores of positive fairness perceptions observed in co-managed protected areas compared to state-dominated ones. Community participation directly enhances perceptions of distributional equity and mediates the influence of governance systems and resource units on such perceptions. Longer-term residency is associated with more negative equity perceptions, while the influences of gender, education, and income vary across locales. These results underscore the importance of local participation in facilitating more positive perceptions of distributional equity in protected areas. To ensure conservation approaches are perceived as fair and equitable, authorities should strengthen transparency and inclusiveness in participation mechanisms. They should also establish adaptive measures to promptly address perceived inequities.
abstract_zh: 分配公平对于保护区与地方发展之间的协调至关重要，因为它影响着地方的合法性、遵从度以及对保护的支撑。然而，塑造当地对此类公平感知的社会-制度机制仍未得到充分理解。运用社会-生态系统框架，我们比较了中国两种典型的治理安排：卧龙自然保护区（国家主导型）和唐家河自然保护区（共同管理型），以考察不同的治理安排和社会经济因素如何共同塑造保护区情境下的公平感知。基于定量问卷（n = 593）和定性访谈（n = 78）的数据，我们的研究结果显示，总体感知的分配公平呈中等偏正面，且共同管理的保护区相比国家主导的保护区，其正面公平感知得分更高。社区参与直接增强了分配公平的感知，并在治理系统和资源单元对此类感知的影响中起到中介作用。较长的居住年限与更负面的公平感知相关联，而性别、教育程度和收入的影响则因地区而异。这些结果强调了地方参与在促进保护区分配公平更正面感知中的重要性。为确保保护措施被视为公平公正，当局应加强参与机制的透明度和包容性，并建立适应性措施以迅速应对感知到的不公平现象。

title: Community Engagement and Public Safety: Evidence from Crime Enforcement Targeting Immigrants
title_zh: 社区参与与公共安全：针对移民的犯罪执法证据
title_primary: 社区参与与公共安全：针对移民的犯罪执法证据
title_secondary: Community Engagement and Public Safety: Evidence from Crime Enforcement Targeting Immigrants
authors: Gonçalves, Felipe, Jácome, Elisa, Weisburst, Emily
official: 卷期日期 2026-08-01 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We study the role of victim reporting in the production of public safety. We examine the Secure Communities program, a crime-reduction policy that involved police in detecting unauthorized immigrants and increased deportation fears in immigrant communities. We find that the policy reduced the likelihood that Hispanic victims report crimes to police and increased offending against Hispanics. The number of reported crimes is unchanged, masking these opposing effects. We show that reduced reporting drives the offending increase and provide the first elasticity of offending to victim reporting in the literature, calculating that a 10% decline in reporting increases offending by 7.9%.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了受害者报案在公共安全产出中的作用。我们考察了“安全社区”计划——一项涉及警方识别非法移民并加剧移民社区驱逐恐惧的犯罪防控政策。研究发现，该政策降低了西班牙裔受害者向警方报案的意愿，并导致针对西班牙裔的犯罪增加。报案犯罪总数未发生变化，掩盖了上述相反效应。我们证明报案减少是犯罪增加的原因，并在文献中首次提供了犯罪对受害者报案的弹性系数，计算得出报案率每下降10%，犯罪率上升7.9%。

title: The Option Value of Municipal Liquidity
title_zh: 市政流动性的期权价值
title_primary: 市政流动性的期权价值
title_secondary: The Option Value of Municipal Liquidity
authors: Haughwout, Andrew, Hyman, Benjamin, Shachar, Or
official: 卷期日期 2026-08-01 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: States and localities are relied upon to implement macroeconomic stabilization policies and ensure service delivery in times of crisis. In April 2020, the introduction of the Municipal Liquidity Facility (MLF) added an emergency lending instrument to the policy arsenal guaranteeing liquidity but at a price. Using a regression discontinuity design that exploits MLF lending eligibility population cutoffs, we find that the MLF contributed to the easing of liquidity pressures and reduced perceived credit risk for municipal borrowers. Low-rated issuers experienced yields reductions of at least 26 bps. We also provide suggestive evidence that these liquidity effects translated into employment gains.
abstract_zh: 各州及地方政府被寄予厚望，需在危机时期实施宏观经济稳定政策并确保公共服务供给。2020年4月推出的市政流动性便利（MLF）为政策工具箱新增了一项应急贷款工具，该工具虽能保障流动性，但需付出相应代价。通过利用MLF贷款资格的人口阈值进行断点回归设计，我们发现MLF有助于缓解流动性压力，并降低了市政借款人的感知信用风险。低评级发行人的收益率至少下降了26个基点。我们还提供了初步证据表明，这些流动性效应已转化为就业增长。

title: Obviously strategy-proof choice of social acts
title_zh: 明显防策略的社会行为选择
title_primary: 明显防策略的社会行为选择
title_secondary: Obviously strategy-proof choice of social acts
authors: Abinash Panda, Anup Pramanik
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-30 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study obviously strategy-proof implementation in the framework of social choice over acts introduced by Bahel and Sprumont (2020). We characterize the class of unanimous social choice functions that are implementable via obviously strategy-proof mechanisms. Our main result shows that a unanimous social choice function is obviously strategy-proof implementable if and only if it is dictatorial.
abstract_zh: 我们研究在Bahel和Sprumont（2020）引入的关于行为的社会选择框架中的显然策略证明实施问题。我们刻画了通过显然策略证明机制可实施的一致社会选择函数的类别。我们的主要结果表明，一个一致社会选择函数是显然策略证明可实施的，当且仅当它是独裁的。

title: Capital Taxation, Income Shifting, and Retained Earnings: Evidence from Dividend Tax Reforms
title_zh: 资本税、收入转移与留存收益：来自股息税改革的证据
title_primary: 资本税、收入转移与留存收益：来自股息税改革的证据
title_secondary: Capital Taxation, Income Shifting, and Retained Earnings: Evidence from Dividend Tax Reforms
authors: Yonatan Berman, Esteban Klor
official: 官方在线 2026-06-27 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper analyzes the effects of dividend tax reforms on tax revenues, income shifting, and earnings retention. It examines two significant policy changes in Israel during the 2010s. Using administrative tax records, we study a permanent five-percentage point increase in the dividend tax rate in 2012, and a temporary tax relief enacted in 2017. The permanent tax hike triggered an immediate surge of over 100% in reported dividend income and tax revenues. It did not generate a lasting shift in dividend flows. In contrast, the temporary relief of 2017 led to a sharp decline in dividend payments upon its expiration. Notably, firms increased earnings retention after the preferential rate ended, potentially anticipating similar future relief. We also find evidence of income shifting via wage-to-dividend conversions for tax planning. Finally, increased earnings retention after 2017 produced a 1–2 percentage point downward bias in the top 1% income share due to unreported dividend income.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了股息税改革对税收收入、收入转移及留存收益的影响。研究聚焦于2010年代以色列两项重大政策变革。基于行政税收记录，我们考察了2012年股息税率永久性提高5个百分点，以及2017年实施的临时性税收减免政策。永久性增税导致申报股息收入及税收收入立即激增逾100%，但并未引发股息流的持续性转移。相比之下，2017年的临时性减免政策在到期后导致股息支付急剧下降。值得注意的是，企业在优惠税率终止后增加了留存收益，这可能是预期未来将出现类似减免措施。我们还发现了通过工资-股息转换进行税务筹划的收入转移证据。最后，2017年后留存收益的增加导致未申报股息收入使顶层1%收入份额产生1-2个百分点的低估偏差。

title: Endowments-swapping-proof object reallocation with transfers
title_zh: 带转移支付的禀赋互换防操纵物品再配置
title_primary: 带转移支付的禀赋互换防操纵物品再配置
title_secondary: Endowments-swapping-proof object reallocation with transfers
authors: Hiroki Shinozaki
official: 官方在线 2026-06-21 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We study the object reallocation problem with transfers. We show that if a rule satisfies endowments-swapping-proofness, strategy-proofness, individual rationality, and no subsidy (or non-imposition), then it is equivalent to the top trading cycles rule without transfers (TTC without transfers). Therefore, even when transfers among agents are permitted, no transfer occurs under the class of rules satisfying these four properties, not even in the form of fixed prices.
abstract_zh: 我们研究带转移的对象再分配问题。我们证明，若某一规则满足禀赋交换防操纵性、策略防操纵性、个体理性及无补贴（或非强制）条件，则该规则等同于无转移的顶级交易循环规则（TTC without transfers）。因此，即便允许代理人之间进行转移，在满足这四个性质的规则类别下，也不会发生任何转移，即便是以固定价格的形式也不会出现。

title: JUE Insight: Technological innovation in mortgage underwriting and the growth in credit: 1985–2015
title_zh: JUE洞察：抵押贷款承销中的技术创新与信贷增长：1985–2015
title_primary: JUE洞察：抵押贷款承销中的技术创新与信贷增长：1985–2015
title_secondary: JUE Insight: Technological innovation in mortgage underwriting and the growth in credit: 1985–2015
authors: Christopher L. Foote, Lara Loewenstein, Paul S. Willen
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-19 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We revisit the evolution of the relationship between mortgage debt and income, adding to the growing literature that extends beyond the 2000s housing boom. Our analysis reveals a permanent decline in the correlation between purchase mortgage amounts and borrower incomes that occurred in the 1990s and was largely complete before the 2000s housing boom. We attribute the decline in the debt–income correlation to a transition in underwriting practices, as lenders moved from human judgment to data-driven statistical models of mortgage default that better identified risky borrowers and enabled broader access to mortgage credit. Using a simple model, we show that patterns observed in the 1990s, including slow price growth and large increases in homeownership, are consistent with a substantial expansion of credit to lower-income households.
abstract_zh: 我们重新审视了抵押贷款债务与收入之间关系的演变，为超越2000年代房地产繁荣的日益增长的研究文献增添了新内容。我们的分析揭示，购房贷款金额与借款人收入之间的相关性在1990年代出现了永久性下降，且这一下降在2000年代房地产繁荣之前已基本完成。我们将债务-收入相关性的下降归因于承保实践的转变，即贷款机构从人工判断转向基于数据的统计模型来预测抵押贷款违约，这些模型能更准确地识别高风险借款人，并促进了更广泛的抵押贷款信贷获取。通过一个简单模型，我们展示了1990年代观察到的模式，包括价格增长缓慢和住房拥有率大幅上升，与向低收入家庭大幅扩大信贷的情况相一致。

title: Anchored to the Dot Plot: Central Bank Projections and Interest Rate Expectations
title_zh: 联邦储备系统理事会
title_primary: 联邦储备系统理事会
title_secondary: Anchored to the Dot Plot: Central Bank Projections and Interest Rate Expectations
authors: Eric Engstrom
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: In January 2012, the Federal Reserve began publishing the Summary of Economic Projections (SEP) "dot plot," revealing FOMC participants' projections for the federal funds rate. This paper documents a dual role for SEP projections in the formation of private interest-rate expectations. On one hand, SEP projections contain valuable information, achieving lower forecast errors than consensus surveys, VAR models, and several market-based measures at many horizons. Because the SEP is informative, some reliance on it by private forecasters is natural. On the other hand, because the SEP is updated only quarterly, SEP projections that are useful when released can become stale between updates. If private forecasts continue to place excessive weight on those earlier projections, they may respond too slowly to newly arriving information. Consistent with this prediction, survey forecast errors-and, to a weaker extent, market-based forecast errors-are systematically related to the gap between current expectations and lagged SEP projections, even after controlling for macroeconomic conditions, risk premia, and other predictors of forecast errors. The findings imply that official guidance can simultaneously improve average forecast accuracy while reducing the speed with which new information is incorporated into expectations.
abstract_zh: 2012年1月，美联储开始发布《经济预测摘要》（SEP）“点阵图”，披露联邦公开市场委员会（FOMC）成员对联邦基金利率的预测。本文揭示了SEP预测在私人利率预期形成中的双重作用。一方面，SEP预测包含有价值的信息，在多个预测期限上，其预测误差低于共识调查、VAR模型及若干市场指标。由于SEP信息含量丰富，私人预测者对其产生一定依赖是自然的。另一方面，由于SEP仅每季度更新一次，发布时有效的预测可能在更新间隔期间变得过时。若私人预测持续过度依赖这些早期预测，则可能对新信息的反应过于迟缓。与这一预测一致的是，调查预测误差（以及程度较弱的基于市场的预测误差）与当前预期和滞后SEP预测之间的缺口存在系统性关联，即使在控制宏观经济状况、风险溢价及其他预测误差预测因子后依然如此。研究结果表明，官方指引能够同时提升平均预测准确性，但会降低新信息融入预期的速度。

title: Central bank communication by ??? The economics of monetary policy leaks
title_zh: 央行沟通的谜题？货币政策泄露的经济学
title_primary: 央行沟通的谜题？货币政策泄露的经济学
title_secondary: Central bank communication by ??? The economics of monetary policy leaks
authors: Michael Ehrmann, Phillipp Gnan, Kilian Rieder
official: 官方在线 2026-06-18 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Using a novel database of media-reported anonymous leaks about monetary policy in the euro area, we conduct the first systematic empirical analysis of these confidential information disclosures originating from central banks. Our database reveals that Eurosystem leaks are frequent — in particular relative to leaks from other major central banks. We provide evidence that many Eurosystem leaks are likely not accidents, but placed strategically by insiders. Exploiting high-frequency financial market reactions to leaks, we find that they have large effects on markets relative to standard monetary surprises, often exceeding the impact of attributed statements by policy-makers. Yet, mainly reflecting minority opinions, leaks do not usually lock in decision-making. Post-meeting leaks regularly reveal information about dissent on the committee, changing market perceptions about the strength of the policy signal. Post-meeting leaks thereby reverse some of the initial market effect of official policy announcements.
abstract_zh: 利用一个关于欧元区货币政策媒体匿名泄密的新颖数据库，我们对源自中央银行内部的这些机密信息披露进行了首次系统性实证分析。我们的数据库显示，欧洲体系内的泄密事件频繁发生——尤其是相对于其他主要中央银行而言。我们提供的证据表明，许多欧洲体系的泄密事件可能并非偶然，而是内部人士策略性安排的。利用高频金融市场对泄密事件的反应，我们发现相对于标准的货币政策意外，这些泄密对市场产生了显著影响，往往超过政策制定者公开声明的效应。然而，主要反映少数派意见的泄密通常不会锁定决策结果。会后泄密经常揭示委员会内部的分歧信息，改变市场对政策信号强度的认知。因此，会后泄密部分逆转了官方政策公告的初始市场效应。

title: Network attrition: Theory and policy implications
title_zh: 网络损耗：理论与政策启示
title_primary: 网络损耗：理论与政策启示
title_secondary: Network attrition: Theory and policy implications
authors: Christophe Bravard, Promit K. Chaudhuri, Sudipta Sarangi, Hector Tzavellas
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-08 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Networks frequently experience attrition as individual members exit over time. Such departures can significantly impact the behavior of their peers and have cascading effects on overall network activity. We investigate such effects within the framework of the canonical linear-quadratic model of peer influence. We introduce an exogenous shock that removes certain agents from the network, with the key feature that only their immediate neighbors observe these departures. In this setting of incomplete information, we characterize the equilibrium behavior using the Bonacich centrality defined over the belief structures of the agents. We propose the concept of an agent’s expected marginal contribution, quantifying the impact of their presence or absence on aggregate network activity. This metric has direct policy relevance: it enables a planner to identify strategically important agents for targeted intervention: either to preserve their participation and enhance collective effort, or to remove them to reduce activity.
abstract_zh: 网络经常因个别成员随时间退出而经历人员流失。此类退出可能显著影响同伴的行为，并对整体网络活动产生连锁效应。我们在经典的线性二次同伴影响模型框架内研究这些效应。我们引入一个外生冲击，从网络中移除某些主体，其关键特征在于只有他们的直接邻居能观察到这些退出。在这种信息不完全的设定下，我们利用基于主体信念结构的博纳奇中心性来刻画均衡行为。我们提出主体预期边际贡献的概念，用以量化其存在或缺失对总体网络活动的影响。这一指标具有直接的政策相关性：它使规划者能够识别具有战略重要性的主体，以进行有针对性的干预——要么维持其参与以增强集体努力，要么将其移除以减少活动。

title: Risky news and credit market sentiment
title_zh: 风险新闻与信贷市场情绪
title_primary: 风险新闻与信贷市场情绪
title_secondary: Risky news and credit market sentiment
authors: Paul Labonne, Leif Anders Thorsrud
source: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The nonlinear nexus between financial conditions indicators and the conditional distribution of GDP growth has recently been challenged. We show how one can use textual economic news and word embeddings to construct an alternative indicator which by design associates growth-at-risk to news about financial conditions. We then document that the proposed indicator is particularly informative about the lower left tail of the GDP distribution and delivers significantly better out-of-sample density forecasts than commonly used alternatives. Speaking to theories on endogenous information choice and credit-market sentiment we further document that the news-based index likely carries information about beliefs rather than fundamentals.
abstract_zh: 金融状况指标与GDP增长条件分布之间的非线性关联近期受到质疑。我们展示了如何利用文本经济新闻和词嵌入构建一个替代指标，该指标在设计上就将增长风险与金融状况新闻相关联。随后，我们证明所提出的指标对GDP分布左下尾尤为信息丰富，并在样本外密度预测方面显著优于常用替代指标。结合内生信息选择与信贷市场情绪的理论，我们进一步记录到，基于新闻的指数可能承载的是关于信念而非基本面的信息。

title: Optimal income taxes and tariffs in a small economy
title_zh: 小型经济体中的最优所得税与关税
title_primary: 小型经济体中的最优所得税与关税
title_secondary: Optimal income taxes and tariffs in a small economy
authors: Elias Dinopoulos, Bulent Unel
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-25 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We introduce a stylized model of an economy with occupational choice, income taxes, and tariffs. The government maximizes a utilitarian welfare function subject to a revenue requirement. In the small open economy (SOE) case, the government implements a free-trade policy, and either imposes a flat tax or a progressive tax on high-income entrepreneurs. In a closed-economy scenario, the government imposes a regressive tax on low-income workers while exempting (or subsidizing) high-income entrepreneurs. A transition from a closed economy to an SOE improves optimal income tax progressivity.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个包含职业选择、所得税与关税的简约经济模型。政府需在满足收入需求的前提下最大化功利主义社会福利函数。在小型开放经济体（SOE）情形下，政府实施自由贸易政策，并对高收入企业家征收统一税率或累进税。在封闭经济情境中，政府对低收入工人征收累退税，同时豁免（或补贴）高收入企业家。从封闭经济向小型开放经济体的转型，会提升最优所得税的累进性。

title: Why Didn't I Get a Payout? Understanding Farmer Choices, Index Insurance, and Basis Risk
title_zh: 为什么我没有获得赔付？理解农户选择、指数保险与基差风险
title_primary: 为什么我没有获得赔付？理解农户选择、指数保险与基差风险
title_secondary: Why Didn't I Get a Payout? Understanding Farmer Choices, Index Insurance, and Basis Risk
authors: S. Lucille Blakeley, Sean Posey, Kathy Baylis, Daniel Osgood, Stuart Sweeney
official: 官方在线 2026-05-07 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Index insurance, while heralded as a potential solution to alleviate poverty and food insecurity among agricultural households, has its own set of challenges, notably basis risk. Basis risk is the discrepancy between the insurance payout and losses incurred, posing a significant deterrent to the adoption of index insurance. This study investigates the effect of basis risk training on the uptake of rainfall index insurance among rural farmers in Senegal, employing an educational simulation game as a pedagogical tool. Our results suggest that a lack of transparency and a misunderstanding of basis risk contribute to low participation and a lack of trust in index insurance.
abstract_zh: 指数保险虽被誉为缓解农业家庭贫困与粮食安全的潜在解决方案，但其自身存在一系列挑战，尤其是基差风险。基差风险是指保险赔付与实际损失之间的差异，这成为阻碍指数保险推广的重要因素。本研究通过教育模拟游戏作为教学工具，探讨基差风险培训对塞内加尔农村农民购买降雨指数保险的影响。结果表明，透明度不足以及对基差风险的误解，是导致参与率低且对指数保险缺乏信任的原因。

title: Assessing the Impact of Separate Biowaste Collection on Residual Household Waste an Analysis at the French Intermunicipal Level
title_zh: 评估单独生物垃圾收集对剩余家庭垃圾的影响：法国市际层面的分析
title_primary: 评估单独生物垃圾收集对剩余家庭垃圾的影响：法国市际层面的分析
title_secondary: Assessing the Impact of Separate Biowaste Collection on Residual Household Waste an Analysis at the French Intermunicipal Level
authors: Aissatou Ndimblane, Olivier Aznar, Kassoum Ayouba
official: 官方在线 2026-04-28 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study evaluates the effectiveness of separate biowaste collection implemented by French local authorities by assessing its impact on the quantities of residual household waste collected per capita. Using a staggered Difference-in-Differences approach, we first examine the dynamic effect of biowaste separation policies on residual household waste. We then explore the heterogeneity of this effect across various economic and sociodemographic contexts, as well as under different waste pricing systems. Our findings reveal that, in the period following adoption, there was a significant average reduction of approximately 19.56 kg per capita in residual household waste among intermunicipal entities that implemented separate biowaste collection. However, this initial reduction is not sustained over time. The heterogeneity analysis shows that low-density areas and intermunicipal entities with limited tourist accommodations experience larger reductions in residual household waste after implementing separate biowaste collection, compared to high-density and high-tourism areas. Furthermore, our results suggest that incentive-based pricing systems significantly contribute to reducing residual household waste. Based on these results, we suggest ways to improve local public waste management policies.
abstract_zh: 本研究评估了法国地方政府实施生物垃圾单独收集政策的有效性，通过分析该政策对人均剩余生活垃圾收集量的影响。采用交错双重差分法，我们首先考察了生物垃圾分类政策对剩余生活垃圾的动态效应，进而探究该效应在不同经济与社会人口背景以及不同垃圾定价体系下的异质性。研究结果显示，在政策实施后的时期内，实施生物垃圾单独收集的市镇联合体人均剩余生活垃圾量平均显著减少约19.56公斤。然而，这一初始减量效果并未持续。异质性分析表明，与高密度和高旅游地区相比，低密度地区及旅游住宿设施有限的市镇联合体在实施生物垃圾单独收集后，剩余生活垃圾减量幅度更大。此外，研究结果提示，基于激励的定价体系对减少剩余生活垃圾具有显著作用。基于上述发现，我们提出了改进地方公共垃圾管理政策的建议。

title: The War of the Pacific and Chilean public revenues: Reallocation of the tax burden and institutional change
title_zh: 太平洋战争与智利公共收入：税负再分配与制度变迁
title_primary: 太平洋战争与智利公共收入：税负再分配与制度变迁
title_secondary: The War of the Pacific and Chilean public revenues: Reallocation of the tax burden and institutional change
authors: Oriol Sabaté, José Peres‐Cajías
official: 官方在线 2026-04-17 · 来源：RSS
abstract: A substantial body of literature has considered warfare a fundamental driver of fiscal capacity. We argue that the nature of the tax base available to governments can either foster or constrain the ability and incentives of central elites to impose their legitimacy once the war is over. We illustrate this dynamic by analysing the evolution of public revenues in Chile before, during, and after the War of the Pacific (1879–83). The seizure of natural resource‐rich areas enabled the Chilean state to raise public revenues and expand its size. This process was driven by a significant increase in natural resource revenues, accompanied by the reduction or decentralization of other revenue sources ‐ outcomes shaped by deliberate policy choices. Over time, the limitations of this arrangement became increasingly evident, paving the way for the introduction of new domestic taxes and investments in fiscal capacity from the early twentieth century onward. While these shifts are crucial for understanding the long‐term development of Chilean state capacity, they proved insufficient to address the short‐term macroeconomic vulnerabilities stemming from the state's dependence on natural resource taxation.
abstract_zh: 大量文献将战争视为财政能力的基本驱动因素。我们认为，政府可获得的税基性质，既能促进也可能制约中央精英在战后强加其合法性的能力与动机。我们通过分析太平洋战争（1879-83年）前后及期间智利公共收入的演变来阐释这一动态。对富含自然资源地区的占领使智利国家得以增加公共收入并扩大其规模。这一过程由自然资源收入的显著增长所推动，同时伴随着其他收入来源的减少或分散——这些结果是由深思熟虑的政策选择所塑造的。随着时间的推移，这一安排的局限性日益显现，为二十世纪初以来引入新的国内税收和财政能力投资铺平了道路。尽管这些转变对于理解智利国家能力的长期发展至关重要，但它们不足以解决因国家依赖自然资源税收而产生的短期宏观经济脆弱性。

title: Raising the inflation target: What are the effective gains in policy room?
title_zh: 提高通胀目标：政策空间的有效增益是什么？
title_primary: 提高通胀目标：政策空间的有效增益是什么？
title_secondary: Raising the inflation target: What are the effective gains in policy room?
authors: Jean-Paul L’Huillier, Raphael Schoenle
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-04-11 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: A macroeconomic setting characterized by higher inflation represents an opportunity to increase a central bank’s inflation target, which can mitigate the risk of future liquidity traps. We show that the gains generated by this strategy are not one-to-one: Because a higher inflation target leads to a steeper Phillips curve, to effectively get, for instance, 2 percentage points of extra room away from the zero lower bound on the interest rate, policymakers need to raise their inflation target from 2% to 5%. Taking this mechanism into consideration changes the optimal inflation target. When the natural rate is near zero, the optimal inflation target is 1 percentage point higher than the optimal target obtained by conventional, earlier, calculations.
abstract_zh: 以较高通胀为特征的宏观经济环境，为中央银行提高通胀目标提供了契机，这有助于缓解未来流动性陷阱的风险。我们证明，这一策略带来的收益并非一一对应：由于更高的通胀目标导致菲利普斯曲线更为陡峭，要有效获得，例如，利率零下限之外额外2个百分点的空间，政策制定者需将通胀目标从2%上调至5%。考虑这一机制会改变最优通胀目标。当自然利率接近零时，最优通胀目标比传统早期计算所得的最优目标高出1个百分点。

title: Pruned skewed Kalman filter and smoother with application to DSGE models
title_zh: 剪枝偏斜卡尔曼滤波与平滑器及其在DSGE模型中的应用
title_primary: 剪枝偏斜卡尔曼滤波与平滑器及其在DSGE模型中的应用
title_secondary: Pruned skewed Kalman filter and smoother with application to DSGE models
authors: Gaygysyz Guljanov, Willi Mutschler, Mark Trede
source: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-03-28 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The skewed Kalman filter (SKF) extends the classical Gaussian Kalman filter by accommodating asymmetric error distributions in linear state-space models. We introduce a computationally efficient method to mitigate the curse of increasing skewness dimensions inherent in the SKF. By analyzing skewness propagation in state-space systems, we develop the pruned skewed Kalman filter (PSKF), which eliminates elements in cumulative distribution functions that do not significantly impact asymmetry beyond a specified threshold. Extensive simulations on univariate and multivariate state-space models validate the PSKF’s accuracy and efficiency. Additionally, we derive the skewed Kalman smoother and its pruned variant, applying them to estimate a New Keynesian DSGE model using US data via standard maximum likelihood and Bayesian MCMC methods. Results strongly favor skewed distributions, particularly for productivity and monetary policy shocks.
abstract_zh: 偏斜卡尔曼滤波器（SKF）通过适应线性状态空间模型中的非对称误差分布，扩展了经典高斯卡尔曼滤波器。我们引入了一种计算高效的方法，以缓解SKF中偏斜维度增加所带来的维数灾难。通过分析状态空间系统中的偏斜传播机制，我们开发了剪枝偏斜卡尔曼滤波器（PSKF），该滤波器在累积分布函数中剔除那些在指定阈值以上对非对称性影响不显著的元素。对单变量和多变量状态空间模型的大量模拟验证了PSKF的准确性和效率。此外，我们推导了偏斜卡尔曼平滑器及其剪枝变体，并将其应用于使用美国数据通过标准最大似然和贝叶斯MCMC方法估计新凯恩斯DSGE模型。结果强烈支持偏斜分布，尤其是对生产率和货币政策冲击而言。
